decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche, long-cycle maritime and defense option whose value resolves slowly and costs little to keep listed, so the option is still worth holding despite being distant from the core offer.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on established certified competence and are being extended with an LED replacement kit, signalling continued investment rather than a resolved, failed option.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the core offer and cheap to carry, but it competes among many similar options in a crowded portfolio, so there is moderate risk it is pruned.
The pendant office luminaire is a recent product close to the core business with low carrying cost and no negative evidence, so the option should be kept while market response resolves.
The premium pendant luminaire is new, fits the established office lighting range, and has no evidence of failure, so keeping the low-cost option is justified.
